name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
summary: Southshore's Chef Jessen wants Soothing Turtle Bisque back on his tavern menu. Unrest has cut off his supply of snapjaw turtle meat, so he asks cooks to brave the northern waters near Dalaran and Lake Lordamere.

sections.title: A Northern Delicacy
sections.body: Southshore is one of the Alliance's last intact coastal towns in Lordaeron, holding to civilian life amid growing strife. Chef Jessen says his cooking rivals any tavern north of Stormwind. Patrons supposedly travel from Darkshire in Duskwood to taste his Soothing Turtle Bisque. The rich soup depends on fresh meat from snapjaw turtles native to the rivers and lakes of the northern mountains.

sections.title: Peril on Lordamere
sections.body: In calmer years, Jessen gathered turtle meat himself, traveling past Dalaran to Lordamere Lake's eastern shore. Rising tensions, hostile wildlife, the Syndicate, and Forsaken incursions have made the lands beyond town deadly for ordinary townsfolk. To keep the bisque on his menu, Jessen depends on armed travelers willing to gather meat from snapjaws along the riverbanks and northern shores.

faq.q: Who offers the quest for Soothing Turtle Bisque?
aliases: where do i start soothing turtle bisque
faq.answer: Chef Jessen, a cook in the Alliance coastal town of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills, makes the request to visiting cooks.

faq.q: Why does Chef Jessen need outside help gathering turtle meat?
faq.answer: Jessen once hunted snapjaw turtles near Dalaran and Lordamere Lake, but unrest and dangerous beasts now make the region too perilous for him to gather meat himself.

faq.q: Where are snapjaw turtles found in the region?
faq.answer: Snapjaw turtles live along the freshwater river between Hillsbrad Foothills and the Alterac Mountains, and along Lordamere Lake's shores north of Dalaran.

faq.q: Do you need to know Cooking to take this quest?
aliases: can anyone take soothing turtle bisque
faq.answer: Yes. Chef Jessen shares the request and his cooking knowledge only with travelers trained in Cooking, though no particular skill rank is needed.
Chef Jessen claims Southshore has the finest cuisine north of Stormwind. His turtle bisque supposedly draws diners from as far away as Darkshire.

faq.q: What is the unrest Chef Jessen laments?
faq.answer: Hillsbrad and Alterac are caught in open conflict with the Forsaken from the north, Syndicate outlaws in the ruins, and wild predators displaced by Lordaeron's fall. Civilian travel has become dangerous.

angles.text: Chef Jessen shares his craft only with fellow cooks, teaching you to prepare your own Soothing Turtle Bisque.
Restoring Southshore's comforts helps keep local spirits up as the town stands isolated against Syndicate outlaws and Forsaken expansion.
As a human from the southern kingdoms, you may find a rare taste of home and hospitality in Jessen's cooking, here in the embattled north.
